Quick runbook notes for Greenbridge:

1) Ledger / tagging
- We'll tag prepay invoices with ledger code GB-PRPAY-2027 so monthly drawdowns map to the committed spend.
- For reporting, include line-level token allocations per invoice (monthly CSV).

2) Bank wiring / AP fields
- We require beneficiary name, IBAN (EU), SWIFT, and an optional Reference field up to 140 chars. For some EU banks we add a beneficiary address line. Please provide the exact XML schema your AP sends so we can map to our bank template.

3) VAT routing
- If invoices are to an Irish subsidiary, we'll issue full VAT invoices to that legal entity. For services where reverse charge applies, we'll include the reverse-charge note and your VAT ID.

4) Escrow / holdback option
- If you want milestone releases (e.g., 40% up front, then monthly sweeps), Legal will need to review SOW language. Otherwise we can do a straightforward deposit + monthly sweep against committed hours/tokens.

I've attached the internal runbook that lists required fields and sample CSVs for monthly token reporting. Monica: can you add the invoice numbering pattern and a sample schedule?

Adding the operational invoice plan for a $300k annual commitment (proposed):

Option A — Monthly sweep (recommended):
- Execution: Invoice 40% upfront (120k) to secure capacity.
- Monthly drawdowns: Remaining 60% split across 6 months (10% per month = 30k/month) with invoices issued on the 1st and paid via wire by the 5th (sweep window).
- Invoice numbers: RBWD-GB-2027-0001 (upfront), RBWD-GB-2027-00xx (monthly).

Option B — Quarterly tranche:
- Execution deposit: 40% upfront
- Tranches: 3 equal tranches on months 0, 4, 8

VAT and cross-border notes:
- If Greenbridge provides Irish VAT ID, we will issue VAT invoices to the Irish legal entity. If reverse charge applies, we will include the statutory language and your VAT ID on the invoice.

Bank wiring / required fields (CSV template attached): beneficiary, IBAN, SWIFT, remittance_ref, PO_number. If Greenbridge requires an XML payload, we'll ask for the schema and adapt.

Attachments: sample_invoice_template.pdf (application/pdf), bank_wiring_instructions.csv (text/csv)

Operational asks for Lisa: VAT ID for the Irish entity, AP contact + expected payment term (NET 5 preferred for sweeps), and whether they want invoices sent to an AP mailbox or to the Irish subsidiary email.
